simple.meaning: אֱהִי (ʼĕhîy) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “where.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 3 times across Hosea, beginning at Hosea 13:10. Its contexts include kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אֱהִי (H165).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: אֱהִי (ʼĕhîy) / H165 is traced through Hosea 13:10, Hosea 13:14 as a generated source-based concept entry.
